queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
s AS (
  SELECT gender, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share
  FROM g
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s
)
SELECT s.gender, s.cnt AS count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_share AS share_minus_average
FROM s, a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share;
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(cnt) AS avg_customers_per_gender
FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customers GROUP BY gender);
SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT gender) FROM Customers WHERE gender IS NOT NULL;
SELECT AVG(share) FROM (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(i.invoice_number) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices i2 JOIN Orders o2 ON i2.order_id = o2.order_id JOIN Customers c2 ON o2.customer_id = c2.customer_id) AS share FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN Invoices i ON o.order_id = i.order_id GROUP BY c.gender)
WITH g AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS cnt
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
),
s AS (
  SELECT gender, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share
  FROM g
)
SELECT gender
FROM s
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s);
